svg.title: Greenland isn't that big
svg.desc: A world map morphs from Mercator to the equal-area Equal Earth projection and back, and Greenland shrinks to its true size. Then Greenland's real outline slides down to the equator on the Mercator map, shrinking as it goes, to sit beside Africa.
